items.text: Araceli Martinez is a small business owner running for State Senate in District 30. Her campaign says she wants to reduce regulations for small businesses while supporting law enforcement and parental rights. On state spending, she proposes auditing Caltrans. She also wants to consolidate overlapping agencies and cut administrative costs. She opposes tax increases and supports suspending the gas tax. She also wants to cut regulations on housing construction. She says she would not support budget cuts to public safety.
